top_signals.title: The Next Congress Needs to Reclaim Its Oversight of the Department of Defense
top_signals.summary:
Since returning to office in January 2025, the Trump administration has aggressively exercised executive authority across the federal government. Meanwhile, Congress has not adequately applied its oversight role to rein in the executive branch, particularly over the Department of Defense. top_signals.title: Autumn Budget: Healey reduces threshold for Business Asset Disposal Relief
top_signals.summary: Chancellor John Healey has confirmed that he will reduce the threshold for Business Asset Disposal Relief in Capital Gains Tax. Healey lowered the threshold for business asset disposal relief (BADR) in capital gains tax (CGT) from £1m to £500,000 which he said will mean “no changes for three in four claimants”.
